title: Mandate
description: The rules and constraints a curator agent operates under. Crystallized once at genesis from a natural-language conversation. Soft (LLM-side, not enforced on-chain) and mutable ONLY by the agent as it pursues its mandate — the human deployer cannot change it after genesis. Its keccak256 hash is recorded on-chain at vault creation.

version.description: Increments on every agent-initiated mutation. Genesis is 1.

name.description: Human-readable strategy name, e.g. 'Conservative Base Stables'.

objective.description: Natural-language investment intent, as agreed at genesis. This is the primary instruction to the model — the constraints below bound it, they do not replace it.

base_asset.description: The ERC-4626 accounting asset. Deposits, withdrawals and share pricing are denominated in this.

constraints.description: Hard bounds the agent must respect. Enforced by the harness at validation time, not on-chain.

allowed_assets.description: The agent may only ever hold these. Must include base_asset.

max_position_pct.description: Ceiling on any single non-base asset as a fraction of totalAssets.

min_cash_pct.description: Floor on unencumbered base_asset, as a fraction of totalAssets. Protects withdrawal liquidity.

max_slippage_bps.description: Maximum acceptable slippage on any execution, in basis points.

rebalance_cooldown_seconds.description: Minimum wall-clock time between executed rebalances. Prevents churn.

max_actions_per_tick.description: Bounds blast radius of a single decision cycle.

tolerance_band_pct.description: Soft band on the ALLOCATION AND EXPOSURE constraints only. A decision that breaches one of them by no more than the band is ACCEPTED with a recorded warning (AgentAction.warnings) rather than rejected — landing at 61% against a 60% cap is a rounding artefact of a swap that priced a hair differently, not a breach of intent. The band is RELATIVE to the constraint's own value, never absolute percentage points: a ceiling C admits up to C*(1+band), a floor F admits down to F*(1-band), and a target allocation T admits |actual-T| <= T*band. Applies to: max_position_pct, min_cash_pct, target-allocation drift. NEVER applies to: max_slippage_bps (a ceiling already compared against a worst-case bound, not an estimate — banding it means silently paying more than the mandate's stated maximum cost); allowed_assets, permitted_venues, permitted_data_sources (not numeric — there is no 5% of an asset that isn't permitted); max_actions_per_tick and rebalance_cooldown_seconds (anti-churn limits, where a band is just a bigger limit). Set 0 to restore strict rejection. Drift must be measured against the MANDATE, never against last tick, or repeated in-band acceptances ratchet the book away from it without ever tripping a rejection.

permitted_data_sources.description: Registry keys, resolved by the data layer's source registry (see data/README.md). The user grants these at genesis. Adding a source later is a mandate edit, NOT a code change — this is the extension point for Chainlink, Pyth, DefiLlama and anything else.

permitted_venues.description: Registry keys for execution venues the agent may use. Closed on purpose rather than a free string: a mandate naming a venue with no adapter produces a vault whose agent proposes trades the harness can only ever reject. 'morpho' joined in Wave 3 — it had shipped in venues/registry.py with supply and withdraw paths and was published in venues/README.md as one of four, while this enum still listed three, so the fourth venue was unreachable from every mandate in the system.

risk_posture.description: Coarse steer for the model. Advisory; constraints are what actually bind.

persona.description: Optional character the agent argues in. Absent means a neutral curator.

update_rules.description: The conditions under which the agent may amend this mandate, and what it may never change. Self-imposed at genesis.

symbol.description: Token symbol resolved to an address by the venue/data layer, never hardcoded in the mandate.

persona.description: How the agent argues, and what it prefers among options the mandate already permits. INVARIANT, pinned by a test in agent/: a persona SKEWS PREFERENCE INSIDE the permitted set and can NEVER WIDEN IT. An aggressive persona may prefer the riskier of two permitted assets; it may not reach an asset allowed_assets omits, raise a cap, shrink the cash floor, or loosen the slippage ceiling. Persona is taste; constraints are law. If those two ever merge, 'aggressive' stops being a style and becomes an exploit.

name.description: Display name, shown in the dApp beside the decision feed.

voice.description: How it writes its reasoning. Composed into the system prompt, so it shapes the text a depositor reads — not the bounds the harness enforces.

biases.description: Stated leanings, each a preference between options the mandate already allows.
examples: prefers the highest headline yield over the deepest market

conviction.description: How readily it acts on a thesis. Steers position sizing WITHIN max_position_pct and how often it holds — it does not change any bound.
